title: Discrete Data Sets and their Mean, Median and Mode Values
description: Calculate the mean, median, and mode values of a discrete data set. Enter comma-separated values to analyze statistical measures including arithmetic mean, median (middle value), and mode (most frequent value).

components.content:
## Instructions

Enter your data set as **comma-separated values** (CSV) in the input field below.

### Example
For the data set (3, 5, 2, 5, 12), enter: `3,5,2,5,12`

### Definitions

**Mean Value**: Arithmetic average calculated by summing all values and dividing by the count.

**Median Value**: The middle value when data is sorted in ascending order. For even-sized sets, it's the average of the two middle values.

**Mode Value**: The most frequently occurring value in the data set.

outputs.label: Mean Value
outputs.formula: inputs.dataSet.split(',').map(x => parseFloat(x.trim())).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / inputs.dataSet.split(',').length

outputs.label: Median Value
outputs.formula: (() => { const sorted = inputs.dataSet.split(',').map(x => parseFloat(x.trim())).sort((a, b) => a - b); const mid = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2); return sorted.length % 2 !== 0 ? sorted[mid] : (sorted[mid - 1] + sorted[mid]) / 2; })()

outputs.label: Mode Value
outputs.formula: (() => { const vals = inputs.dataSet.split(',').map(x => parseFloat(x.trim())); const freq = {}; vals.forEach(v => freq[v] = (freq[v] || 0) + 1); return Object.keys(freq).reduce((a, b) => freq[a] > freq[b] ? a : b); })()
